  have h_main : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        -- Base case: when n = 0, we directly use the zero value.
        exact zero
      | n + 1 =>
        -- Inductive step: for n + 1, we need to use the bit function.
        have h₁ := ih ((n + 1) / 2) (by
          -- Prove that (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1.
          have h₂ : (n + 1) / 2 < n + 1 := by
            apply Nat.div_lt_self
            <;> omega
          omega
        )
        -- Use the bit function to construct the result for n + 1.
        have h₂ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit ((n + 1) % 2 = 1) ((n + 1) / 2) := by
          have h₃ := Nat.mod_add_div (n + 1) 2
          have h₄ : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          rcases h₄ with (h₄ | h₄) <;> simp [h₄, Nat.div_eq_of_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left] at h₃ ⊢ <;>
            (try omega) <;> (try omega) <;> (try omega) <;> (try ring_nf at * <;> omega)
          <;> omega
        -- Use the bit function to construct the result for n + 1.
        rw [h₂]
        exact bit ((n + 1) % 2 = 1) ((n + 1) / 2) h₁
  exact h_main n
